summary: Merged todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T030.md into a single unified contract body per Owner decision #5. Removed the top `Contract status: FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778` marker and the standalone 2026-09-16 Owner amendment block; folded every binding instruction from /tmp/owner_decision_T030.txt into Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must-not and References. Implementation status now states that src/robinhood_lp/storage/schema.py and related tests are pre-existing unverified implementation handled under WORKFLOW.md migration rule, and enumerates the still-open gaps (dependency verification, full typed reconstruction, ProtocolFeeUpdated, schema-v1 migration, provenance/content identity separation, and the contract-enumerated tests). Deliverables now distinguish T030 logical schema from T031 Parquet physical layout (Decision #2), make the acquisition envelope/manifest fields (endpoint alias, retrieval time, request interval, HTTP batch metadata) explicitly observational, and bind normalized event identity and content hash to T011 EventKey (chain_id, block_hash, tx_hash, log_index) so cross-provider fetches produce the same normalized content hash while both raw envelopes are retained. Acceptance adds explicit cross-provider content-hash equality, retention of two raw provenance observations, fork-log distinction by block hash, and the credential-bearing URL prohibition. Must-not forbids writing credential-bearing URLs into any layer. References now include R4, R9, ADR-002, ADR-010, ADR-011. A `Binding direction reference` subsection at the end of the contract lists the relevant Owner decision numbers and /tmp/owner_decision_T030.txt as an audit trail.
rationale: The merge is required because the prior T030.md expressed the contract in two layers (frozen-from-baseline marker plus a top amendment block); Owner decision #5 makes the amendment binding direction and instructs the Planner to consolidate it into a single unified contract body, forbidding the Developer from picking one layer. Owner decision #1 mandates that the existing src/robinhood_lp/storage/schema.py plus related tests be labelled pre-existing unverified implementation under the WORKFLOW.md migration rule, with the still-open gaps explicitly enumerated; the new Implementation status subsection does exactly that, citing the migration rule and naming every gap the contract still requires the Developer to close. Owner decision #2 separates T030 (logical schema) from T031 (Parquet column/partition/manifest layout) and preserves ADR-002 while refining field semantics through ADR-010; the new Deliverables section explicitly owns the logical schema, defers physical encoding to T031, keeps ADR-002 closed, and pins acquisition provenance to the raw envelope/manifest while excluding it from the normalized content hash so A and B fetches compare equal. The Acceptance, Must-not and References sections reflect the same decisions verbatim. No implementation, task state, attempt counter, evidence pointer, commit SHA, runtime model, or approval datum in todo/config.yaml was changed; only the contract body inside the planning lane was edited, which is what CONTRACT_MISMATCH triage authorises.
